name: intel-devkit-verify
description: Check whether the Intel AI PC Developer Kit, OpenVINO GenAI, and OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) are ready on Windows for a local chat model. Use before installing the Dev Kit, starting OVMS, or connecting Hermes or another agent to local models. Read-only: it does not install software or download weights. If the user asked only for a check, report the result and stop. Follow next_skill only when their request includes that next step. Not for installing OVMS, switching Hermes off the cloud, or VS Code Continue.
